packages.title: CVF Engineering API And Interface Design
packages.purpose: Guide contract-first API, module, schema, and component-boundary design while preserving CVF source verification and deprecation discipline.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Browser Runtime Verification
packages.purpose: Guide browser-based verification with DOM, console, network, accessibility, and screenshot evidence under CVF untrusted-data and profile-isolation boundaries.

packages.title: CVF Engineering CI/CD Quality Gates
packages.purpose: Guide CI/CD quality gate design, pipeline evidence, and deployment automation planning without authorizing production deployment by package load.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Code Review Quality
packages.purpose: Guide multi-axis code review across correctness, readability, architecture, security, and performance using CVF finding-first review discipline.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Code Simplification
packages.purpose: Guide behavior-preserving simplification and debt reduction while requiring comprehension, tests, and project-convention alignment before refactor.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Debugging And Error Recovery
packages.purpose: Guide systematic root-cause debugging, reproduction, and error recovery using CVF diagnostic and evidence discipline.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Deprecation And Migration
packages.purpose: Guide deprecation, migration, compatibility, and sunset planning with explicit consumer-impact and rollback boundaries.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Frontend UI
packages.purpose: Guide production-quality frontend UI work while binding output to CVF DESIGN.md, responsive layout, accessibility, and runtime verification requirements.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Incremental Implementation
packages.purpose: Guide small, reviewable implementation slices with validation after each slice and clear stop conditions for governed work.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Observability And Instrumentation
packages.purpose: Guide logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and production diagnostic evidence without claiming live/provider behavior unless separately proven.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Performance Optimization
packages.purpose: Guide measurement-first performance optimization and regression control across frontend, backend, database, and build surfaces.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Planning And Task Breakdown
packages.purpose: Guide conversion of clear requirements into ordered, dependency-aware, testable tasks under CVF work-order and closure discipline.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Security Hardening
packages.purpose: Guide threat-model-first hardening for authentication, authorization, untrusted input, secrets, external integrations, and sensitive data.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Shipping And Launch
packages.purpose: Guide launch readiness, rollback planning, staged rollout, monitoring, and release evidence without authorizing production deployment.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Source-Driven Development
packages.purpose: Guide official-documentation-backed implementation decisions for framework or library work where current source correctness matters.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Spec-Driven Development
packages.purpose: Guide source-backed specification before non-trivial implementation, including assumptions, commands, structure, testing, and boundaries.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Test-Driven Development
packages.purpose: Guide failing-test-first implementation, bug reproduction, regression coverage, and proof that behavior works before closure.

packages.title: CVF Engineering Test Evidence Audit
packages.purpose: Give an advisory KEEP/REPAIR/CONSOLIDATE/ADD/DEFER_WITH_REASON disposition for one asserted existing-proof claim tied to a named source file and a named test file, by reading the actual test assertions rather than trusting the claim sentence or a docstring.

packages.title: CVF Governance Context Engineering
packages.purpose: Guide session/context setup, rule discovery, and context-budget discipline for agents without promoting provider-local memory to CVF authority.

packages.title: CVF Governance Documentation And ADRs
packages.purpose: Guide decision records and durable documentation so future agents can understand why a governed change exists and how it should be used.

packages.title: CVF Governance Doubt-Driven Development
packages.purpose: Guide adversarial fresh-context review of non-trivial decisions to reduce hallucination, rationalization, and shallow PASS closeout.

packages.title: CVF Governance Git Workflow And Versioning
packages.purpose: Guide disciplined branching, commits, conflict handling, and versioning while preserving CVF material/session-sync commit separation.

packages.title: CVF Governance Idea Refinement
packages.purpose: Guide early idea refinement from vague intent into options, constraints, and an actionable governed next move.

packages.title: CVF Governance Operator Interview
packages.purpose: Guide one-question-at-a-time clarification when operator intent is underspecified and a risky assumption would distort the work.

packages.title: CVF Governance Skill Discovery And Invocation
packages.purpose: Guide metadata-first skill discovery, invocation boundaries, and skill selection without global instruction loading or authority expansion.

packages.title: CVF Governance Worker-Return Review
packages.purpose: Guide Local reviewer assessment of internal worker returns, reviewer-local repair routing, and evidence-supported bounded closure.
